core_projects.title: Autonomous Career Operations Engine
core_projects.description: End-to-End AI-Agentic Job Application Architecture built natively within the Antigravity IDE. It evaluates roles, generates tailored cover letters, distills recruiter insights, and autonomously applies to jobs using deterministic sub-shell executions and headless state management.
innovations: SKILL.md Agentic Separation: Replaces monolithic prompting with modular SKILL.md files chained via Workflows. This avoids context bloating by only loading necessary skill modules on demand.

Zero API/Token Costs: Driven entirely within the Antigravity IDE, the architecture avoids expensive external endpoints by leveraging the model quota (Claude and Gemini families) available from the AI Coding Assistant.

The Self-Healing Loop: When the browser subagent encounters unknown application questions, it pauses for user input (HITL) and permanently rewrites the YAML database (interview-answers.yaml) to never make the same mistake twice.

Multi-Level Conditional Branching & Logic Gating: Orchestrator mandates an absolute >90% score calculation from three disparate expert skills (score-jd, ats-check, recruiter-review) before branching into programmatic browser execution.

Non-Destructive Multimodal Document Consolidation: Generates the ultimate source of truth by natively parsing and deduplicating Resume PDFs and LinkedIn Profiles into a master experience-library.yaml without external dependencies.

The Autonomous Apex Macro Orchestrator: A single, overarching command seamlessly manages state across disparate application environments (LinkedIn Easy Apply vs. Workday ATS), transforming isolated chat interactions into a deterministic programmatic event sequence.

Proactive URL Sanitization & HITL Authentication Injection: Bypasses aggressive tracking/auth walls by cleanly extracting IDs natively. Injects a strict Human-In-The-Loop pre-processing step for the browser subagent to enforce login pauses.

Headless Session State & Native Memory Grepping (Zero-Latency Deductions): Eliminates repetitive parameter passing via a globally managed CLI context (active-session.yaml). Leverages explicit grep_search across local memory to map abstract URLs instantly, avoiding costly WebFetch executions.
core_projects.visual_architecture: Features an overarching Apex Orchestrator bridging 'Context & Ingestion' (Native LLM Parsing) to 'Sequential Workflows' (Fit, Gap, ATS Check, DOM Input Mapping) empowered by headless state automation and deterministic anti-blocking. Uses SKILL.md for precise execution without context bloat.
core_projects.execution_evidence: Fully autonomous pipeline gracefully handling Easy Apply and Workday systems using native IDE tools with Zero API cost.
